fixes.explanation: Yes, the herdsmen of Gerar. Isaac's servants had found a well of fresh water in the valley (Gen 26:19). Then Gerar's herdsmen quarrel with Isaac's herdsmen and say, “The water is ours!” (Gen 26:20) Isaac named the well Esek, because they contended with him. Somebody found water and somebody else filed a claim. I've seen that kind of thing over a parking spot.

Trust sounds like a nice reason, but it isn't the one in the text. Isaac was afraid, and he thought, “The men of this place will kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is so beautiful.” (Gen 26:7) I think a man who's scared for his life isn't thinking about winning anybody's trust. He's just trying to get through the day, and that sister line came out of a scared place.

Guilt. Abimelech says, “One of the people could easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.” (Gen 26:10) I think he's rattled by what could have happened. And I think Isaac didn't see that part coming when he said she was his sister.

Handing it all to the king isn't what happens. The LORD blessed Isaac, and then “…he became richer and richer, until he was exceedingly wealthy.” (Gen 26:13) Nobody's passing him a collection plate. The verse only goes one way, and that's up. I wish my cookie jar worked like that.

Yes. “…the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham.” (Gen 26:15) Those wells went back to Abraham, Isaac's father. Dirt was the tool, and it was all of the wells. That's a lot of shoveling just to make a point.

Nope, Isaac isn't talking about his flocks and herds. He says, “You hated me and sent me away.” (Gen 26:27) That's about how they treated him, not what they took. Picture him standing there, arms crossed, and out comes that one line. Short and it lands.

Mocking isn't what Isaac says. He tells them, “You hated me and sent me away.” (Gen 26:27) The text gives him only those words to them here, and nothing about his God or his altar. Hated and sent away is the whole charge, and I think it carries plenty of sting by itself.
